Compose_Complete_Run_Record.inputs:
@setProperty(
  outputs('Compose_Base_Run_Record'),
  'telemetry_persistence',
  setProperty(
    setProperty(
      setProperty(
        setProperty(
          json('{}'),
          'definition_lookup',
          setProperty(
            setProperty(
              setProperty(
                json('{}'),
                'attempted',
                true
              ),
              'status',
              coalesce(
                actions('Get_Flow_Definition')?['status'],
                'Unknown'
              )
            ),
            'error',
            coalesce(
              actions('Get_Flow_Definition')?['error'],
              json('{}')
            )
          )
        ),
        'sharepoint_create',
        setProperty(
          setProperty(
            setProperty(
              setProperty(
                setProperty(
                  json('{}'),
                  'attempted',
                  true
                ),
                'status',
                coalesce(
                  actions('Create_Flow_Telemetry')?['status'],
                  'Unknown'
                )
              ),
              'item_id',
              int(
                coalesce(
                  outputs('Create_Flow_Telemetry')?['body']?['ID'],
                  outputs('Create_Flow_Telemetry')?['body/ID'],
                  0
                )
              )
            ),
            'response',
            coalesce(
              outputs('Create_Flow_Telemetry')?['body'],
              json('{}')
            )
          ),
          'error',
          coalesce(
            actions('Create_Flow_Telemetry')?['error'],
            json('{}')
          )
        )
      ),
      'sharepoint_readback',
      setProperty(
        setProperty(
          setProperty(
            setProperty(
              json('{}'),
              'attempted',
              equals(
                actions('Create_Flow_Telemetry')?['status'],
                'Succeeded'
              )
            ),
            'status',
            coalesce(
              actions('Get_Item_Flow_Telemetry')?['status'],
              'Unknown'
            )
          ),
          'item',
          coalesce(
            outputs('Get_Item_Flow_Telemetry')?['body'],
            outputs('Create_Flow_Telemetry')?['body'],
            json('{}')
          )
        ),
        'error',
        coalesce(
          actions('Get_Item_Flow_Telemetry')?['error'],
          json('{}')
        )
      )
    ),
    'capture_completed_at_utc',
    utcNow()
  )
)
